title: Concurrent Stock Deduction Race
hints: Guard against invalid quantities (`$quantity <= 0`) and insufficient stock (`$this->available < $quantity`) before mutating `$this->available`.

Only decrement `$this->available -= $quantity;` when the guard passes, and choose pessimistic locking (`lockForUpdate`) or an atomic conditional `UPDATE ... WHERE stock >= ?` for production databases.

decisionOptions.label: Add usleep(50000) before updating the stock row to space out requests.
Use a database transaction with pessimistic locking (lockForUpdate) or an atomic conditional UPDATE ... WHERE stock >= ?.
Disable the checkout button in Vue for 2 seconds and keep non-atomic PHP updates.
